test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My grandfather was a farmer and he ___________three acres of land.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cultivated'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cultivated** means to prepare and use land for growing plants for food or to sell.

 
 
• Ex-Olives have been **cultivated** for centuries in the Mediterranean countries.
 
 
 
• ​In this question, the use of the verb **'cultivated'** fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is: *My grandfather was a farmer and he **cultivated** three acres of land.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Advanced** means to move forward.
 
• **Grown **means(used about plants) to exist and develop in a particular place; to make plants grow by giving them water, etc.
 
• **Cultured** means well educated, showing a good knowledge of art, music, literature, etc.
